proof_scope: Skills-first project setup planning/auditing, including default client-contract gates from requirements/brief inputs.

claims.proves: setup-project can emit a read-only setup plan, audit setup surfaces, and automatically require acceptance-contract, Battle, and create-report evidence for client/evaluator requirement specs.
claims.does_not_prove: full project generation, production deployment, cloud apply, or a real Battle campaign for every project.

capability_claims.description: The skill emits a typed read-only plan for setting up the OpenAI interview project with the required skill chain.
The skill audits the OpenAI interview repo for README skill provenance, curate-client handoff, immutable goal, Docker/Terraform files, and retained eval fixture.
A config with requirements_spec defaults to the client-contract release gate and fails closed without Battle/report evidence.

cases.name: openai-plan-includes-curate-client
command: ../run.sh plan --config ../configs/openai_interview.yaml | python3 -c 'import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); assert d["schema"]=="setup_project.plan_receipt.v1" and d["status"]=="PASS"; assert "curate-client" in d["required_skills"]; assert d["curate_client_plan"]["status"]=="PASS"; print("SETUP_PLAN_OK")'

cases.name: openai-audit-proves-readme-and-goal
command: ../run.sh audit --config ../configs/openai_interview.yaml | python3 -c 'import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); assert d["schema"]=="setup_project.audit_receipt.v1" and d["status"]=="PASS"; assert d["curate_client_plan_status"]=="PASS"; assert d["curate_client_verify_status"]=="PASS" and d["curate_client_probe_count"] >= 5; assert d["immutable_goal_valid"] is True; assert d["assembly_evidence"]["schema"]=="setup_project.assembly_evidence.v1"; assert d["assembly_evidence"]["commit_count"] >= 1; assert not d["missing_readme_terms"]; print("SETUP_AUDIT_OK")'

cases.name: audit-fails-when-required-file-missing
command:
TMPD=$(mktemp -d); git clone --quiet --local /home/graham/workspace/experiments/openai-interview $TMPD/project; rm $TMPD/project/README.md; python3 - <<PYCODE > $TMPD/config.yaml
import yaml
from pathlib import Path
d=yaml.safe_load(Path('../configs/openai_interview.yaml').read_text())
d['project_root']='$TMPD/project'
print(yaml.safe_dump(d))
PYCODE
../run.sh audit --config $TMPD/config.yaml >/tmp/setup_project_missing_file.out 2>/tmp/setup_project_missing_file.err; test $? -eq 1; grep -Fq 'missing_files' /tmp/setup_project_missing_file.out

cases.name: audit-client-contract-gate-with-battle-and-report
command:
TMP=$(mktemp -d); PROJ=$TMP/project; mkdir -p $PROJ/artifacts/acceptance $PROJ/artifacts/battle $PROJ/artifacts/report; cat > $PROJ/README.md <<'EOF'
# Demo
EOF
cat > $PROJ/BRIEF.md <<'EOF'
# Brief
The project must use acceptance-contract before implementation.
EOF
cat > $PROJ/spec.json <<'EOF'
{"remove":["secret"]}
EOF
cat > $PROJ/immutable_goal.json <<'EOF'
{"schema":"demo.immutable_goal.v1","classification":"internal","spec_inputs":["BRIEF.md","spec.json"],"completion_criteria":["Acceptance bundle is bound before implementation."]}
EOF
cat > $PROJ/artifacts/acceptance/acceptance_bundle.json <<'EOF'
{"schema":"acceptance_contract.bundle.v1","project_name":"demo","source":{"kind":"file","path":"BRIEF.md","sha256":"aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa","files":[]},"requirements":[{"id":"REQ-001","kind":"must","statement":"Use acceptance-contract before implementation.","source_path":"BRIEF.md","source_line":1,"evidence_text":"must use acceptance-contract"}],"acceptance_cases":[{"id":"AC-001","requirement_id":"REQ-001","kind":"MUST_VERIFY","predicate":"Bundle exists","deterministic_check":"test -f artifacts/acceptance/acceptance_bundle.json","proof_artifacts":["artifacts/acceptance/acceptance_bundle.json"]}],"open_questions":[],"immutable_goal":null,"non_claims":["No implementation proof."]}
EOF
cat > $PROJ/artifacts/battle/campaign.json <<'EOF'
{"schema":"battle.campaign_contract_receipt.v1","verdict":"PASS","case_receipts":[],"aggregation":{"schema":"battle.campaign_aggregate.v1","cases_total":0,"cases_passed":0,"failed_count":0,"incomplete_count":0,"failures":0}}
EOF
cat > $PROJ/artifacts/report/release.json <<'EOF'
{"schema":"create_report.report.v1","title":"Release gate","sections":[]}
EOF
git -C $PROJ init -q && git -C $PROJ config user.email test@example.com && git -C $PROJ config user.name Test && git -C $PROJ add . && git -C $PROJ commit -q -m init; cat > $TMP/config.yaml <<EOF
schema: setup_project.config.v1
classification: internal
project: demo
project_root: $PROJ
purpose: demo
immutable_goal_schema: demo.immutable_goal.v1
required_skills:
  - acceptance-contract
required_files:
  - README.md
  - immutable_goal.json
requirements_spec:
  brief: BRIEF.md
  spec_inputs:
    - BRIEF.md
    - spec.json
acceptance_contract: artifacts/acceptance/acceptance_bundle.json
battle_receipts:
  - artifacts/battle/campaign.json
release_report: artifacts/report/release.json
EOF
../run.sh audit --config $TMP/config.yaml | tee /tmp/setup-project-client-contract-audit.json && python3 - <<'PY2'
import json
d=json.load(open('/tmp/setup-project-client-contract-audit.json'))
assert d['status']=='PASS'
assert d['client_contract_gate']['enabled'] is True
assert d['client_contract_gate']['status']=='PASS'
assert 'battle' in d['required_skills']
assert 'create-report' in d['required_skills']
print('SETUP_PROJECT_CLIENT_CONTRACT_GATE_OK')
PY2
